name: BEAM Phishing
rootCause: On February 16, 2024, a BEAM token holder lost approximately $5.14 million (180.25 million BEAM) on Ethereum to a phishing-induced token allowance scam. The attack exploited a user-signed approval, enabling a rapid extraction and liquidation of BEAM for ETH. The victim was deceived into signing an ERC-20 allowance granting the attacker unlimited BEAM token spending rights. No BEAM protocol or contract vulnerability has been reported or demonstrated.
